facts.name: Landmark
facts.address: 1300 South University Ave, Ann Arbor, MI 48104
facts.specials: Apply and sign for any 2-bedroom or 4-bedroom apartment within 48 hours and receive a $500 gift card! Restrictions may apply. Call the leasing office for more details.

fees.other: Renters Liability Insurance (third party): Varies/leaseholder/monthly (required); Utility Billing Administrative Fee: $5.94/leaseholder/installment (required); Parking - Garage: $250.00/item/installment (optional); Renters Liability/Content - Property Program: $14.50/unit/monthly (optional); Situational fees include: Access Device Replacement ($25-$75), Intra-Community Transfer ($250), Late Fee ($50), Lease Violation (Varies), Payment Services (Varies), Reletting Fee ($250), Renters Liability Non-Compliance ($10.75/monthly), Returned Payment Fee ($25).

facts.utilities: Internet included. Electricity, gas, water/sewer are usage-based and required. Billing administrative fee $5.94/leaseholder/installment.
facts.notes: Total Monthly Leasing Price includes base rent, all monthly mandatory and any user-selected optional fees. Excludes variable, usage-based, and required charges due at or prior to move-in or at move-out.
